summary:
Indian equity markets are closed today, 19 September 2026, for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 21 September.
In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended their losing streak to six weeks due to crude oil pressures and US Fed rate worries.
Maruti Suzuki remains in focus following its green vehicle targets, while Paytm stays on trader radar.
